title: Input representation of restricted Fourier weight
statement: Let $n\in\mathbb N$, let $F:\{−1,1\}^n\to\{−1,1\}$, let $J\subseteq\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$, and let $S\subseteq J$. For three independent uniformly distributed full sign vectors $Z,Y,Y'\in\{−1,1\}^n$, split $Z$ into its coordinates outside $J$, and split each of $Y,Y'$ into its coordinates in $J$. The expected restricted Fourier weight observation formed from these pieces and the real-valued sign function associated to $F$ equals the restricted Fourier weight of that real-valued function at $J,S$.
hypotheses_covered: Three independent uniform full sign vectors
